study type: Secondary analysis of prospectively collected data
exposure: Duration of latent phase of labor
duration of the latent phase of labor
outcome: Interventions to ameliorate dystocia (e.g., oxytocin augmentation)
Length of active phase and second stage
cohort: 1,189 women with low-risk pregnancies and spontaneous labor
finding: Longer latent phase duration was associated with labor dystocia, interventions to ameliorate dystocia, epidural use, and longer active phase and second stage, but not with increased risk for cesarean delivery or postpartum hemorrhage.
mod_finding: Longer duration of the spontaneous latent phase of labor was associated with a higher likelihood of labor dystocia, interventions to manage dystocia, and epidural use, but not with increased risk for cesarean delivery or postpartum hemorrhage.
